title: Double-checked body size limits (Content-Length + actual bytes) should be defended
description: Every response body check in fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob first inspects Content-Length as an early exit, then enforces the same limit on the actual bytes read. A future contributor might simplify to one check. Both checks are necessary: Content-Length is optional and servers can lie (RFC 7230 §3.3), so the actual-bytes check is the security boundary. Removing the Content-Length check loses the early-exit optimization; removing the actual-bytes check is a security regression.
